cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: dance · /dæns/ · verb · Word · New
move your body to music. Puck can sing but cannot dance.
join in · /ˌdʒɔɪn ˈɪn/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to take part in an activity with other people. Come and join in our dance.
sing along · /ˌsɪŋ əˈlɔŋ/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to sing while listening to someone else sing. We sing along with our favorite song.
tap your foot · /ˌtæp jɚ ˈfʊt/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to move your foot lightly against the floor, often with music. Tap your foot with the music.
dancer · /ˈdænsɚ/ · noun · Word · New
a person who dances, especially as a job. The dancer moves across the stage.

articulation.label: sing
articulation.alt: sing: /s/ → /ɪ/ → /ŋ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/ŋ/: Back of tongue at soft palate; air through nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
